evals.name: retail-bank-branches
evals.prompt: Our retail bank is redesigning its branch network and digital channels. Use Three Horizons to map the transition from today's model to what comes next and classify our current initiatives.
evals.expected_output: Three Horizons map with H1 (current branch model losing fit), H3 (emerging successor, with concrete pockets of the future), H2 innovations classified H2+ or H2-, features of H1 worth keeping, a dilemma, and horizon perspectives; not the McKinsey growth horizons.

evals.name: newsroom-transition
evals.prompt: We lead product design at a regional newspaper. Apply Three Horizons to the future of local news so the newsroom and the commercial team can talk about the transition.
evals.expected_output: Three Horizons for local news: H1 advertising/print model, H3 emerging models with pockets in the present, H2 experiments classified +/-, what to maintain, manager/entrepreneur/visionary perspectives on each other, and next actions.

evals.name: school-meals-service
evals.prompt: A city council wants to redesign its school meals service around health and sustainability. Use Three Horizons to structure the conversation among catering managers, nutritionists and parent groups.
evals.expected_output: Three Horizons mapping with the five steps, H2+ and H2- initiatives, essential features to keep, a dilemma framed between H1 and H3 values, and dialogue between horizon perspectives.
